title: Floating Oil Rig Garden
description: A surreal floating island made of green rock hovers in a starry night sky, supporting a colorful oil rig structure topped with a blooming yellow tree. The rig is wrapped in glowing purple rings while a large blue spotted alien creature with antennae stands beside it, surrounded by giant yellow flowers and dripping rainbow liquid.
prompt: Surreal floating green rock island in a starry night sky with crescent moons, supporting a rusty orange and teal oil rig structure wrapped in glowing purple rings. A large blue spotted alien creature with antennae stands next to it. The rig is topped with a flowering tree full of yellow blossoms. Large yellow flowers grow on the island with purple and rainbow liquid dripping from the edges. Rainbow arcs across the background with colorful drips, whimsical and dreamlike atmosphere.
